description: This file contains utility functions and components for rendering and interacting with deck.gl layers in a Superset frontend plugin, including tooltip handling, color scaling, aggregation functions, and event handlers.

methods.name: commonLayerProps
methods.description: Generates event handlers and tooltip logic for deck.gl layers based on form data and callbacks.

methods.name: getAggFunc
methods.description: Returns an aggregation function based on specified type and accessor, supporting sum, count, percentiles, and other d3-array functions.

methods.name: getColorForBreakpoints
methods.description: Determines the color breakpoint index for a data point based on an aggregation function and color breakpoints.

methods.name: getColorRange
methods.description: Generates a color range array based on color scheme type, fixed color, breakpoints, or color scale.
